visualReview.notes: Actually inspected84 final image pixels:11 portable,11 shared-material,27 medium-fi lighting/LOD and35 normal-placement terrain views. Five official Riigikogu exterior photographs were inspected as primary visual references. Pink palace, curved central/triangular end pediments, grey four-wing parliament, three roofless courts, limestone west curtain and three surviving towers remain legible. Original master is preserved; independent derivative corrects Tall Hermann height and fits northern block floors and buried foundations to retained ground. Palace and parliament exterior arcades have open approaches with closed backing/door reserves; no through-building or navigable-interior claim. Dedicated palace-front apron and terrain views inspect fitting contact. Flat shared views expose normally buried foundations and cannot establish ground fit. Photograph-based arches, window/roof rhythm and ornament remain reconstructed.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All11 final shared-material pixels inspected. Three reusable graphs supply limestone, lime plaster and ceramic tile, with visible stone courses, plaster and roof patterns. Local opaque PBR supplies glass, trim and static geometric flags. Skyline bakes actual common linear means into one draw. Each graph loads once in the production library; no embedded images or per-model photographic textures. Flat-ground screenshots expose buried masonry and are only material/axis checks. Common palette and texture scales are stylized, not exact photographic matching.
